content:
OSKAR HADDAD-LINDQVIST
Full-Stack Developer | TypeScript, React & Node.js
Gothenburg, Sweden | +46 70 555 0808 | oskar.hl@example.com
GitHub: oskarhl-example | Blog: oskar-codes.example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack developer with professional web application experience since 2014, building user-facing products with React, TypeScript, Node.js and SQL databases. Experienced in implementing features end to end, including accessible interfaces, backend services, database integrations, automated testing and cloud deployment. Recent work includes a BankID identity-verification flow that increased onboarding conversion from 61% to 74%, and frontend performance improvements that reduced mobile LCP from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds. Fluent in English and accustomed to working closely with designers and cross-functional teams.

CORE SKILLS
Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, Angular, AngularJS, Vue, React Native, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Storybook, Redux, React Query, jQuery
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, PHP, Laravel, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma, TypeORM
Testing and delivery: Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker
Cloud and tools: AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, CloudWatch, RDS), Linux, Nginx, Varnish, Terraform (modifying existing files), Figma, Jira, Confluence, Sentry, Datadog, Unleash
Additional: Web accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA, Agile/Scrum, BankID

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Full-Stack Developer | Älvgrind Fintech AB, Gothenburg
2021–Present
- Build and improve customer onboarding features in React and TypeScript, with Node.js and NestJS services and PostgreSQL data storage.
- Developed a new identity-verification flow integrating the BankID API, including QR-code handling, error states and retries. A/B tested with 10% of traffic before full rollout; onboarding conversion increased from 61% to 74%.
- Implemented document uploads using S3 presigned URLs, ClamAV virus scanning in Lambda, and upload status handling with SQS and PostgreSQL.
- Helped migrate legacy Express services to NestJS and maintain a GraphQL backend-for-frontend with another developer.
- Improved frontend performance through code splitting, image optimization, removing Moment.js and replacing a large charting library; reduced mobile LCP from 4.1 seconds to 1.9 seconds. Also implemented server-side rendering for marketing pages with Next.js.
- Fixed accessibility issues in the onboarding flow against WCAG 2.1 AA and migrated the frontend from Create React App to Vite in 2023.
- Work with designers in Figma; contribute to on-call rotations and candidate interviews. The onboarding team received the 2023 internal Customer Impact Award.
- Technologies include TypeScript, React, NestJS, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Jest, Playwright, Storybook, Sentry, Datadog and Unleash.

Developer | Sjöbris Digital Agency AB, Gothenburg
2018–2021
- Built websites and web applications for approximately 25 clients across retail, transport, local government and sport.
- Developed client applications with Angular and React, and a campaign site with Vue; built backends using Node.js/Express and PHP/Laravel.
- Co-developed a React Native ticket-purchasing app for a ferry company, reaching approximately 50,000 downloads; served as project tech lead.
- Created and maintained custom WordPress themes and plugins and introduced GitLab CI for the agency.
- Worked with MySQL, MongoDB and Firebase.

Web Developer | Nordkust Media AB, Gothenburg
2014–2018
- Developed newspaper websites and an article editor using PHP, jQuery and AngularJS.
- Implemented a paywall integration and configured Varnish caching.
- Performed some Ubuntu Linux server administration and worked with MySQL.

Freelance Web Developer / Student
2012–2014
- Built websites for friends, family, a local bakery and two bands using PHP, jQuery and WordPress.

EDUCATION
Bachelor in Computer Science | West Coast University College (Högskola), Gothenburg
2011–2014 | Graduated 2014

Additional learning: Advanced React Patterns (2022); AWS Cloud Practitioner course (2020, exam not taken).

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE & LANGUAGES
- Coding bootcamp mentor, Gothenburg (evenings), 2019–2020.
- Speaker, local JavaScript meetup, 2022: “Migrating Express to NestJS without stopping the world”.
- Swedish: Native | English: Fluent (work language) | Arabic: Spoken at home; limited writing | German: Basic, school-level
- Driving licence: B
- Interests: Bass guitar, climbing, board games and home automation.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear reverse-chronological experience, a focused headline, relevant technical grouping, quantified achievements, and credible evidence of impact. The BankID conversion improvement and LCP reduction are particularly persuasive. The document is substantially more professional and concise than the original candidate information while preserving the important technical details. Minor opportunities remain to make the strongest regulated-environment and Git-workflow experience more explicit for this specific role.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is strong: the CV uses conventional section headings, plain text formatting, bullet points, recognizable technology names, and no tables, graphics, columns, or unusual formatting that would impair parsing. It contains most high-value keywords, including React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Jest, Playwright, AWS, Docker, Storybook, accessibility, and A/B testing. AI screening probability is high for the core full-stack requirements and good for the nice-to-have requirements. Screening may be slightly weaker for the exact phrases “Git-based workflows,” “semantic HTML,” “responsive layouts,” “OWASP Top 10,” and health-data privacy, although the candidate information does not substantiate all of those areas.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV is a very strong match for the core engineering scope: it demonstrates substantially more than two years of React and TypeScript experience, Node.js and SQL backend work, automated testing, AWS and Docker, Next.js SSR, Storybook, accessibility work, and A/B testing. The fintech onboarding and KYC-related identity-verification work is relevant to the ad’s regulated-environment and security-sensitive context, although direct healthcare experience is not shown. Fluent English is clearly shown. Basic German is listed, which is a helpful but limited match for the language preference. The candidate's material does not establish semantic HTML, responsive-layout knowledge, OWASP Top 10 awareness, or health-data privacy experience; these are genuine requirement gaps rather than CV-writing defects and should not be implied or added without evidence. The CV does show accessibility work against WCAG 2.1 AA, while the employer specifies WCAG 2.2 AA, so the document should not claim the newer standard.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR, HIGH-VALUE CV IMPROVEMENTS:
1. In the current Älvgrind Fintech AB role, revise the first bullet from “Build and improve customer onboarding features in React and TypeScript...” to “Build and improve customer onboarding and KYC features in React and TypeScript, with Node.js/NestJS services and PostgreSQL data storage.” This uses the candidate’s documented KYC experience and makes the regulated-environment relevance more visible.
2. In the “Testing and delivery” subsection of Core Skills, change the heading to “Testing and Git-based delivery” and change the opening technology list to “Jest, Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library, Supertest, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI.” This makes the job’s “Git-based workflows” terminology more explicit without adding an unsupported tool or experience.
3. In the current Älvgrind role, retain the existing BankID and S3/ClamAV bullets, but consider adding “third-party API integration” once in a truthful form, for example: “Integrated the BankID third-party API, implementing QR-code handling, error states and retries.” This improves keyword alignment with the role’s requirement for third-party integrations while accurately reflecting the documented work.
